dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged outer perimeters of at least four prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures in the upper dorsal-right quadrant, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient from dark charcoal exterior to pale grey/white interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of clustered, non-gradient light-pixel blobs located primarily in the central dorsal region, showing no internal symmetry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle, while additional smaller centroids in the central region create an elongated, irregular polygonal relationship.
